2609.31382.title: Highlight-Then-Summarize: Learning to Compress Evidence for Long-Context Understanding
2609.31382.paper_summary: Long-context understanding requires large language models (LLMs) to reason over lengthy documents, conversations, and code, yet task-relevant evidence is often sparse and scattered amid substantial irrelevant and redundant content. We propose Highlight-Then-Summarize (H2S), a compress-then-reason paradigm that first identifies source-grounded, question-relevant evidence and then integrates it into a compact, question-conditioned summary before producing the final answer. To train this behavior, we construct H2S-Dataset, comprising 6,647 examples from 11 benchmark families with an average context length of 43.9K tokens, and introduce H2S-RL, which provides process-level rewards for evidence selection and summary construction in addition to final-answer correctness. We evaluate on H2S-Bench, a seven-task long-context suite. Under a shared 128K input and 4K output budget, H2S-14B achieves an average score of 32.60, outperforming Qwen3.8-27B by 10.17 points and obtaining the strongest overall result among the evaluated open-source models. H2S-14B also achieves the highest Evidence-Summary Quality score and retains 97.1% of its 16K-budget performance with only a 4K output budget. These results show that explicitly selecting and integrating evidence improves long-context reasoning while enabling more compact generation.
2609.31382.paper_summary_zh: 長文理解需要大型語言模型 (LLMs) 在冗長的文件、對話和程式碼中進行推理，但與任務相關的證據往往稀少且分散在大量無關和冗餘的內容中。我們提出了 Highlight-Then-Summarize (H2S)，這是一種先壓縮再推理的範式，首先識別基於來源的、與問題相關的證據，然後將其整合成一個緊湊的、以問題為條件的摘要，最後生成最終答案。為了訓練這種行為，我們構建了 H2S-Dataset，包含來自 11 個基準系列的 6,647 個範例，平均上下文長度為 43.9K 代幣，並引入 H2S-RL，該方法除了最終答案的正確性外，還為證據選擇和摘要構建提供過程層級的獎勵。我們在 H2S-Bench 上進行評估，這是一個七任務的長文套件。在共享的 128K 輸入和 4K 輸出預算下，H2S-14B 的平均得分為 32.60，超過 Qwen3.8-27B 10.17 分，並在評估的開源模型中獲得了最強的整體結果。H2S-14B 還獲得了最高的證據-摘要質量得分，並在僅有 4K 輸出預算的情況下保留了 97.1% 的 16K 預算性能。這些結果顯示，明確選擇和整合證據可以改善長文推理，同時實現更緊湊的生成。
